Dallas has one of the more generous big-city programs: **free monthly brush and bulky collection, no appointment, up to 10 cubic yards per address.** The catch is precision. The set-out window is narrow and enforced, and a couch at the curb on the wrong day earns an Orange Tag and possibly a citation.

## The Dallas Sanitation Rules, Exactly

- **Once a month**, on your neighborhood's assigned collection week. Find your week at Dallas.gov/sanitation, the Dallas Sanitation Services app, or 311.
- **Set-out window: Thursday through Sunday before your collection week**, in place by 7 AM Monday. Earlier is an early set-out violation.
- **10 cubic yards per month**, roughly a heaped pickup bed. A once-a-year oversize exemption up to 20 cubic yards can be requested through 311 the week before.
- **Brush and bulky items in separate piles**, at least three feet apart. A mixed pile may be partially left.
- **Eligible:** single-family homes and duplexes with city sanitation service.
- Transfer stations accept resident drop-offs with proof of Dallas residency if you'd rather not wait for your week.

## When Monthly Isn't Soon Enough

A couch that misses this month's window waits until next month's, and HOA staging rules in many Dallas neighborhoods conflict with the city's four-day set-out window, which leaves residents choosing which rule to break. Apartments and larger buildings aren't eligible at all.

When those apply: [couch removal in Dallas](/tx/dallas/couch-removal/) starts at $90, carry-out included, [same-day in most ZIPs when booked before 2PM local time](/book-online/), with [donation pickup](/tx/dallas/donation-pickup/) for furniture that [passes condition standards](/blog/eco-friendly-living/can-couch-be-donated/). Pricing by item is in the [cost guide](/blog/junk-removal/how-much-does-couch-removal-cost/).

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Does Dallas pick up couches for free?

Yes, once a month for single-family homes and duplexes with city service, up to 10 cubic yards, set out Thursday through Sunday before your collection week.

### When can I put a couch at the curb in Dallas?

Only from the Thursday before your collection week through 7 AM the following Monday. Earlier set-outs get Orange Tags and can draw citations.

### What is the Dallas 20 cubic yard exemption?

Once per calendar year, residents can request an oversize collection of up to 20 cubic yards through 311, submitted the week before their regular collection week.

### What's the fastest way to remove a couch in Dallas?

Booked removal on your date, not the calendar's: [same-day across most of Dallas](/tx/dallas/couch-removal/) when booked before 2PM local time, carried from inside your home.
